summary: Inno Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $3.0 million Development Services Agreement with a Hong Kong AI service provider to build an AI-powered used mobile phone sales system. The contract is payable in five milestone-based installments through May 31, 2027, with IP rights vesting solely in the company. This is a routine service agreement, not a special-situation event. No terms involving acquisitions, divestitures, or any other special-situation category are present.
